query: SELECT event_type,action,actor_login,created_at,updated_at,title,body,comment_id,comments,state,closed_at,file_time,repo_name,number FROM github_events WHERE repo_name='sourcegraph/sourcegraph' AND number=792 AND event_type IN ('IssuesEvent','IssueCommentEvent') ORDER BY created_at,file_time FORMAT JSON

data.title: Options page: Include privacy notice
data.body:
User feedback that we are missing telemetry information in the extension (https://twitter.com/hsribei/status/1031541560121483266)

In the options page add another section for privacy with the following text:

> Sourcegraph integrations never send any logs, pings, usage statistics, or telemetry to Sourcegraph.com. They will only connect to Sourcegraph.com as required to provide code intelligence or other functionality on public code. As a result, no private code, private repository names, usernames, or any other specific data is sent to Sourcegraph.com.
>
> If connected to a private, self-hosted Sourcegraph instance, Sourcegraph browser extensions will send notifications of usage to that private Sourcegraph instance only. This allows the site admins to see usage statistics.

Also include links to:
- [Privacy](https://about.sourcegraph.com/privacy)
- [Terms](https://about.sourcegraph.com/terms)
